# Horse Racing Companion

> An independent iPhone app for Del Mar race days. It turns public odds,
> relevant Del Mar history, scratches, and live race-day updates into one clear
> pick for nearly every race, with estimated chances, confidence, and reasons
> that are easy to understand. It also explains when a race is too unclear for
> a pick and saves every final pick beside the official result. It does not
> accept wagering funds, place or send wagers, or connect to a betting operator.
> Any wagering transaction happens outside the app.
> It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Del Mar Thoroughbred
> Club.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). The first three racing days are free and include
  complete race-day picks. After that, the app may offer one non-renewing
  pass for the displayed Del Mar season. The app and App Store show the exact
  price and access end date before purchase, and the pass never renews
  automatically. It is not a deposit, wagering balance, credit, virtual
  currency, or payment method for a wager. Race cards, results, and the
  how-it-works explanation stay free without a pass.
- The analysis uses public information only: morning-line odds and past Del
  Mar results (each horse's local record, trainer, jockey, their pairing, and
  post-position performance by surface and distance). No profit is guaranteed
  and pick confidence is not a win probability.
- Predictions are explicitly labeled by outcome type, including Win, Place,
  or Show where applicable. The strongest pick is highlighted; genuinely
  unclear races retain the top-ranked horse with Low confidence. No Pick is
  reserved for insufficient history or a hard data/safety failure. Pick confidence is
  shown as a visual meter, not a win probability. Race detail may show an
  estimated total return for the track's minimum stake using current odds;
  final pools and post-time odds determine any actual payout.
- There is no adjustable stake control, teller wording, betting-window
  instruction, wagering account, deposit flow, operator connection, or wager
  execution or transmission.
- Live picks normally begin about two hours before the day's first
  race. The app shows that day's expected opening time. Before then,
  "Live Picks Open Later" is a normal scheduled state; "Live Updates
  Delayed" is reserved for missing fresh data after the window opens.
- Live record across four tracked cards on August 20–22 and August 27, 2026:
  14 of 31 finalized pre-race picks matched their published result type (45.2%)
  across 35 settled races; the app passed the other 4 races instead of forcing
  a pick. Every pick was saved before the official finish was known. All four
  cards used public-card v0.4 with ticket-policy v0.4. This small sample does
  not establish profitability or a proven betting edge.
- Responsible wagering: for adults of legal wagering age where wagering is
  lawful. Problem-gambling help: https://www.ncpgambling.org/
